export function subscriptionQuote(units: number): number {
  return metering.usageQuote(units, 0.1, "monthly").amount / metering.chargeUnit;
}

export function subscriptionLabel(account: string, units: number): string {

evidence.reason: Left edit changes evaluate plan from "monthly" to "benchmark" and removes metering.initialize(), altering the pre-edit behavior that callers/tests relied on.
Right edit changes default plan from undefined to "benchmark", so callers omitting plan now get "benchmark" instead of the previous default behavior.
Caller explicitly passes "monthly" to usageQuote, so it is unaffected by the right edit's default change but still relies on the original plan semantics.
Tests assert evaluate(20,0.1,"monthly") and usageQuote(30,0.1,"monthly") behave as before, and call subscriptionCharge(40) which now uses "benchmark".
